audit.why: Nami's poke wins the hook-dodging early game, Blitzcrank's Level 4-6/1st-item combo (Grab into Power Fist into Static Field) deletes through sustain, Nami reclaims at 2+ items when grouping limits a single-target hook — matches whys[].

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns calls Rocket Grab matchup-defining but has no cooldown number anywhere.
audit.why: Rocket Grab (Q) is 20/19/18/17/16s and Power Fist (E) is 7/6.5/6/5.5/5s — the actual combo-cooldown pressure a laner needs to track.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three missing-interaction flags unaddressed: Mana Barrier (P) / Static Field (R) shield absorbs burst, Power Fist (E) is an auto-attack-reset tell, and activated Static Field silences (denies Flash/summoners as an answer).
audit.why: Committing burst into an unforced shield wastes the all-in; the E wind-up (not the cast) is the actual step-back cue; and once he activates R you cannot cast anything to escape for its duration.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1] now covers the E wind-up tell with real cooldowns, dontsFull[2] covers dumping burst into the shield, report[9] warns about the silence.

edits.before: - Blitzcrank Rocket Grab: matchup-defining — The hook IS the champion — minion cover turns the lane into a farming sim. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your Q Aqua Prison answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Rocket Grab is down 20s at rank 1, 16s at rank 5 — the hook IS the champion, so minion cover turns the lane into a farming sim while it's up. - Your Q Aqua Prison answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.

edits.before: W the bounce through carry-and-support, E your carry, auto — the trade healed you, billed them, and buffed the follow-up.
edits.after: The instant a hook lands, Power Fist follows within 7-5s — bubble the grabbed target immediately, since the wind-up (not the cast) is your last chance to react.

edits.before: Throwing the bubble at poke range out of boredom — the stun is the matchup; the rest is salad.
edits.after: Mana Barrier and an activated Static Field both shield him at low health — force the shield out with poke first, don't spend your combo into it.

edits.before: Commit on Rocket Grab’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. His answer goes first; yours goes last.
edits.after: Commit on Rocket Grab’s cooldown — but once he activates Static Field it silences you, so nothing you need to answer it should be pre-cast.
